applicabilityBasis.summary: CSCBUSDC represents shares in Clearstar cbAssets Vault, a USDC lending vault on Base at 0x91c056b6d4311a743614fbc03ac32d4e6a2d3a3c curated by Clearstar. Morpho Vault V2 aggregates allocated strategy assets, accrues lending returns and recognizes losses in share value. Redemption depends on the current share-to-asset conversion and available liquidity rather than an issuer obligation to redeem each share for a fixed amount of national currency.

genius.notes: Reviewed as a variable-value strategy-vault share against the GENIUS Act section 2(22) payment-stablecoin definition. The USDC underlying and its Circle issuer are assessed separately; their authorizations and attestations are not attributed to this share. The website terms opened on 2026-10-07 name NovaFusion S.A., Panama, as website operator under the Clearstar brand and Clearstar Labs AG as licensor, describe Clearstar as a vault curator, and defer vault use to third-party protocol terms. Neither entity is established as a fixed-dollar redemption obligor, so issuerEntity is omitted. This row does not resolve securities, fund, lending or interface regulation.
